children.name: Gymnogongrus durvillei
children.description: Gymnogongrus durvillei is a species of red algae in the family Phyllophoraceae.

children.name: Gymnogongrus griffithsiae
children.description: Gymnogongrus griffithsiae is a small uncommon seaweed.

children.name: Mastocarpus papillatus
children.description: Mastocarpus papillatus, sometimes called Turkish washcloth, black tar spot, or grapestone is a species of red algae in the family Phyllophoraceae.

children.name: Mastocarpus stellatus
children.description: Mastocarpus stellatus, commonly known as carrageenan moss or false Irish moss, is a species in the Rhodophyceae division, a red algae seaweed division, and the Phyllophoracea family.

children.name: Schottera nicaeensis
children.description: Schottera nicaeensis is a species of red algae (Rhodophyta) similar to other small red algae particularly Phyllophora.

children.name: Phyllophora crispa
children.description: Phyllophora crispa is a medium-sized fleshy, marine red alga.

children.name: Phyllophora sicula
children.description: Phyllophora sicula, the hand leaf bearer, is a small red marine alga.

children.name: Phyllophora gelidioides
children.authorship: P.L. Crouan & H.M. Crouan ex Karsakoff
